opening.argument: The speaker promotes Forsage BUSD through claimed personal earnings tied to a team and an upline structure. She says “from here we have earned rupees 50,000,” describes a team of 10–15 people, and identifies an upline with an associated ID. Alongside new participant IDs, payments and instant amounts, these details present participation and recruitment as the route to money. The invitation is direct: “so start up, keep working,” reinforced by the assurance that “you can make a good profit over here.” This is a solicitation built around recruitment commissions and a tiered structure, using claimed earnings to encourage viewers to join and work quickly. The evidence supports that scam solicitation without establishing actual losses or realized profits for viewers.
